default/32564.htm.text: Magister Papiku: Bam ba bam ba bah! I'm the singing magister, Papiku! Why am I in a good mood? Well, the passage to Gracia -- which had been blocked for hundreds of years -- has finally been opened! That's good, since the Gracian people desperately need our help. And we can have the use of the fabl…

Q10267_JourneyToGracia/32564-01.html.text: Magister Papiku: Do you know that the airship is a part of the ancient Giants' legacy? Apparently they they left behind quite a few relics in Gracia. Most of the continent has been devastated, but perhaps Keucereus will be able to use these relics to prevail. A surprising twist, isn't it? Now what …

links.text: Show him High Priest Orven's letter.

Q10267_JourneyToGracia/32564-03.html.text: Magister Papiku: Is there something wrong? Please do not delay! Take High Priest Orven's letter to the commander at Keucereus Alliance Base , Admiral Keucereus himself.

Q10267_JourneyToGracia/32564-02.html.text: Magister Papiku: Ah, just from the seal on the letter, I surmise that you must be the one dispatched here by High Priest Orven! If you take the airship, you can reach Keucereus Alliance Base quickly. Once there, show the letter to the commander, Admiral Keucereus .
